constraints.statement: The 8 published S1.P05 record models and 1 vocabulary enum are a bounded pull-request history surface. S1.P06 must consume them without redefining them and must not read the surface as a complete development history.
S1.P05.S07 evidence association is LEVEL 1 record-level only and must not be implicitly upgraded by S1.P06.
S1.P06 does not own a generic Git ancestry or reachability graph.
The historical default branch remains unknown and is owned by S2. A current observation must never be substituted for historical truth.
The published S1.P05 contracts and the development-history v1 corpus are frozen. Semantic change requires the repository's append-only correction or versioning mechanism rather than silent mutation.
